Subject: Pilot kickoff & success criteria — Redwood × Meridian Analytics

Hi Alyssa —

Great conversation earlier. Per our demo, attached is a concise pilot playbook (redwood-pilot-playbook-v1.pdf) and a proposed evaluation schedule (meridian-eval-schedule.xlsx). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we land on scope and owners before the kickoff: 

High-level goal:
- Run a 4-week evaluation pilot to validate latency and cost improvements for the document-classification pipeline and measure end-to-end accuracy retention vs your current baseline.

Proposed success criteria (suggest you confirm/add):
- Throughput: sustain 250 concurrent classification requests with 95th pct latency < 350ms
- Cost: per-1000-doc token cost reduction >= 35% vs current infra
- Accuracy: F1 score within 1.5% of current model baseline on the anonymized eval set
- Reliability: <1% error rate (timeouts/failed inferences) during peak windows

Owners & asks:
- Meridian: provide a representative, anonymized eval dataset (10k docs) and a short list of critical edge-case examples by May 14
- Redwood (Karthik): technical kickoff + setup (model variant, quantization profile, KV caching)
- Redwood (Vivek): success tracking and weekly status cadence; will prepare dashboards and cost/LAT dashboards

Timeline (proposed):
- Confirm success criteria & dataset: by May 14
- Technical kickoff (30–45m): week of May 17
- Pilot execution: May 24 — June 20 (4 weeks)
- Wrap & recommendations: by June 25

Attachments: redwood-pilot-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook), meridian-eval-schedule.xlsx (timeline grid).

Can you confirm: (1) the success criteria above, (2) dataset availability, and (3) whether procurement should be looped now or after we agree scope?

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff & success criteria — Redwood × Meridian Analytics

Neha — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. Helpful. Quick responses inline: 

Success criteria:
- Throughput & latency: agree with the 250 concurrent / 95th <350ms target.
- Cost: the 35% target is reasonable as a stretch goal; can we include a secondary metric for median latency as our UX team watches that closely?
- Accuracy: agree to F1 within 1.5% but we will add an operational tolerance check for the top-10 most frequent labels.
- Reliability: agree.

Dataset: we can provide an anonymized 10k doc set by May 13. We'll include a small separate file of the 50 edge-case docs you asked for.

Procurement: please loop Procurement now — they will need a short SOW and an estimated cost table to get a PO in place. I copied them above.

One ask from our security team: please include a short bullet summary of data handling during the pilot (where data lives, retention, deletion process). If you can attach that as security-briefing-summary.pdf that would help speed procurement.

Proposed kickoff: any time during the week of May 17 looks good for us; we prefer Tuesday or Wednesday mornings (PDT).

Thanks — Alyssa

Alyssa Morgan
Head of AI Programs
Meridian Analytics
alyssa.morgan@meridiananalytics.com | +1 (650) 555-0110
